body: Zero-size position misclassified as short in flip check. `willFlipPosition` treats a zero-size position (`size: '0'`) as `'short'` because `0 > 0` is false. A sell market order against this phantom 'short' position matches direction and returns `false` (no flip), so `shouldHandleTpslSeparately` becomes false. The TP/SL then goes through the single `perpsPlaceOrder` call with `normalTpsl` grouping — the exact scenario this PR aims to prevent. Adding a zero-size guard at the top of `willFlipPosition` to return `false` would let the `!position` fallback in the caller handle it, or treating zero as a no-position scenario directly.
action: Treat zero-size position as no-position in the order-entry caller before `willFlipPosition`; routes the market+TPSL through the two-step `perpsUpdatePositionTPSL` flow that yields `grouping: 'positionTpsl'`.
